body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2008') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics showcased its latest twin-LCD clamshell handset 'Style Report(model: SCH-W570, SPH-W5700)' during KES(Korea Electronics Show) 2008. The Style Report phone is equipped with a 2.2-inch external touch screen for enjoying mp3 player, photo viewer and DMB functions. It also supports 'Personal UI' that allows users to create their own interfaces and menu on the desktop. Other features included GSM/WCDMA global roaming service, a 3M built-in camera, T-DMB, Bluetooth connectivity and mp3 playback. It is now available in Korea market for between 600,000(KRW) and 700,000(KRW).
